name: Casa Del Toro
summary: Casa Del Toro is a luxury 7-bedroom villa in Getsemaní, Cartagena, offering an exceptional blend of historic charm, modern comfort, and privacy-first service. Fully renovated in October 2024, this private villa features an expansive ground-floor pool, a rooftop terrace with hot tub and daybeds, and seven oversized bedrooms — each with a king-size bed and en-suite bathroom. Located steps from the Walled City, Casa Del Toro is ideal for groups seeking a refined, walkable, and authentic Cartagena experience.

villaTokens.arrivalRouteSummary: 15-minute private airport transfer directly to the villa door. As a city-center property, no boat transfer is required for arrival.

villaTokens.walledCityAccessSummary: A 5-minute walk through the Centenario Park takes you directly to the Clock Tower and the main Walled City entrance.
villaTokens.getsemaniAccessSummary: You are located on one of Getsemaní's most iconic streets. Plaza de la Trinidad is a 3-minute walk away.
villaTokens.bocagrandeAccessSummary: 10-minute taxi ride (approx. $3-5 USD) to the modern skyscrapers, shopping malls, and beaches of Bocagrande.

villaTokens.staffDescription: A dedicated daytime cook and maid (7:00 AM – 4:00 PM) and a live-in administrator providing 24/7 security.
villaTokens.groceryPolicy: Our staff handles grocery shopping at premium markets and local fish vendors. We present receipts for reimbursement plus a 10% service fee.

content.overview:
Casa Del Toro was designed for guests who want space, privacy, and location without compromise. The villa's layout balances generous shared areas with quiet private suites, making it ideal for family vacations, group travel, milestone celebrations, or extended stays in Cartagena.

The first floor centers around a private pool and social living area, while the rooftop terrace offers a secluded escape with a hot tub and lounge seating — perfect for sunset drinks or relaxing between excursions. Every detail reflects thoughtful upgrades, contemporary finishes, and functionality for modern travelers.
content.location: Casa Del Toro is located in Getsemaní, one of Cartagena's most sought-after historic neighborhoods. Known for its colorful streets, art scene, and vibrant dining culture, Getsemaní offers a more authentic and walkable experience while remaining steps from the Walled City's main attractions. Walking distance to Plaza de la Trinidad, Clock Tower & Old City gates, restaurants, cocktail bars, cafés, cultural landmarks and nightlife. Bocagrande's beaches and shopping districts are a short taxi ride away, and island excursions depart easily from nearby marinas.

testimonials.quote: Mark's place is exactly how it's listed online but even better in person. The staff are awesome, attentive and amazing. We felt safe, well tended to and at peace. The place was clean, beautiful and felt like home. Walking distance from all shops, restaurants, and entertainment. I had the best vacation and will definitely be back!

We stayed here for my bachelorette trip and it was absolutely perfect! The house itself is stunning and located in the perfect area. Gilberto, our butler, was everything we didn't know we needed—attentive, thoughtful, and always one step ahead. The house maids cooked us the most delicious meals. This experience exceeded all of our expectations.

This house was absolutely amazing—felt like a resort. It's huge with plenty of space, very clean and well kept. The location was unbeatable, close to everything within walking distance, and it comes with security that makes you feel safe. If I'm ever in Cartagena this will be the place I'm booking.
